<thought>Based on the mass (183 Da), carbonyl at 169 ppm, a methyl singlet (CH₃‑CO), a benzylic CH₂ attached to oxygen (4.6 ppm), and a para‑disubstituted aromatic ring (four aromatic protons), the most consistent structure is p‑acetoxy‑benzyl alcohol. Its SMILES representation is “CC(=O)Oc1ccc(cc1)CO”.</thought>
<final_answer>CC(=O)Oc1ccc(cc1)CO</final_answer>
